# RadonFixers

> RadonFixers (https://radonfixers.com) is a referral and information service that connects homeowners with independent, state-licensed radon mitigation contractors. RadonFixers does not perform radon testing or mitigation installs and does not employ contractors. Contractor listings are copied from official state licensing records (Pennsylvania DEP, Minnesota Department of Health, Illinois Emergency Management Agency), and health and cost information cites EPA, state health departments and named cost surveys. It is a project of Robert Companies LLC, Austin, TX.

## Source authorities
- Pennsylvania DEP Bureau of Radiation Protection: https://files.dep.state.pa.us/RadiationProtection/RadonDivision/RDPortalFiles/2026/10_01/WebMitigationAlpha.pdf
- Minnesota Department of Health Indoor Air Unit: https://radon.web.health.state.mn.us/serviceProviders.faces
- Illinois Emergency Management Agency (IEMA-OHS): https://public.iema.state.il.us/Radon/Home/LicenseIndex
- US EPA, A Citizen's Guide to Radon: https://www.epa.gov/sites/default/files/2016-12/documents/2016_a_citizens_guide_to_radon.pdf
- US EPA, Action level for radon: https://www.epa.gov/radon/what-epas-action-level-radon-and-what-does-it-mean
- US EPA, Map of Radon Zones: https://www.epa.gov/radon/epa-map-radon-zones-0
